name: Mythic Clockwork Mage
body:
Mythic Clockwork Mage
CR 12/MR 4

XP 19,200
N Medium construct (clockwork, mythic)
Init +14; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +17

DEFENSE

AC 30, touch 18, flat-footed 22 (+6 Dex, +2 dodge, +12 natural)
hp 142 (15d10+60)
Fort +7, Ref +13, Will +9
DR 10/adamantine and epic; Immune construct traits; SR 24
Weaknesses vulnerable to electricity

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 4 slams +20 (1d6+3 plus 2d8 force damage)
Ranged 4 force blasts +23 touch (3d8 force damage)
Special Attacks force blast, mythic power (4/day, surge +1d8), mythic spell-like abilities, wand magic
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 15th; concentration +20 (+24 casting defensively); see below)

STATISTICS

Str 16, Dex 23, Con —, Int 20, Wis 14, Cha 10
Base Atk +15; CMB +20; CMD 38
Feats Combat Casting, Combat Reflexes, Great Fortitude, Greater Spell Focus*, Improved Natural Attack (slam), Iron Will, Improved InitiativeB, MF, Lightning ReflexesB, Spell Focus*, Weapon FocusMF (slam)
Skills Knowledge (arcana, planes, any three others) +19, Perception +17, Spellcraft +19
SQ awakened construct, difficult to create, simple arcane spellcasting, swift reactions, winding
Languages Common

* The Spell Focus feats match the arcane school of the wand crystal. If the arcane school is abjuration, the mythic clockwork mage has two item creation feats instead

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Awakened Construct (Ex)

A mythic clockwork mage is a sentient being, awakened in the process of its creation, and can understand the language of its creator.

Force Blast (Su)

A mythic clockwork mage can fire a force blast as an attack action or four force blasts as a full-attack action.

These blasts are ranged touch attacks with a maximum range of 100 feet. Each force blast deals 3d6 points of damage. Additionally, the construct adds 2d8 points of force damage to each slam attack. This is a force effect.

Spell-Like Abilities (Sp)

A mythic clockwork mage’s spell-like abilities depend on the arcane school of the wand crystal.

It uses the higher of its Intelligence or Charisma modifiers to determine its spell DCs. The construct can apply the Spell Focus feat and Greater version to the save DCs of these spell-like abilities, and it can expend a use of mythic power to activate a spell-like ability without it counting against the number of uses per day. Different mythic clockwork mages may have different spell-like abilities (to a maximum of 24 total spell levels useable per day).

Abjuration: 1/day—break enchantment, dimensional anchor, globe of invulnerability, greater dispel magic, protection from energy
Conjuration: 2/day—dimension door; 1/day—black tentacles, solid fog, summon monster VI, summon swarm
Enchantment: 1/day—dominate person (DC 22), greater heroism, mass suggestion (DC 23), power word blind
Evocation: 1/day—chain lightning (DC 23), forcecage (DC 24), freezing sphere (DC 23), wall of force
Illusion: 3/day—shadow conjuration (DC 21); 2/day—shadow evocation (DC 22)
Necromancy: 3/day—enervation; 2/day—fear (DC 21); 1/day—greater false life
Transmutation: 1/day—disintegrate (DC 23), erase, overland flight, slow (DC 20), stone shape, water breathing, whispering wind
Wand Magic (Su)

A mythic clockwork mage’s wand crystal allows it to cast spells as if using a spell trigger magic item (CL 9th; concentration +14 (+18 casting defensively)). The arcane school of the wand crystal determines the construct’s spells. They cast 1st-level spells at will, 2nd-level spells 3 times per day, and 3rd level spells 1 time per day. The construct uses its Intelligence modifier to determine its spell-like ability save DCs, and it can expend a use of mythic power to activate a spell-like ability without it counting against the number of uses per day. Finally, the construct can apply the Spell Focus feat and Greater version to the save DCs of its wand magic.

Abjuration: 1st—hold portal, shield; 2nd—protection from arrows, resist energy; 3rd—dispel magic
Conjuration: 1st—grease (DC 18), summon monster I; 2nd—glitterdust (DC 19), web (DC 19); 3rd—stinking cloud (DC 20)
Enchantment: 1st—bungle (DC 18), sleep (DC 18); 2nd—daze monster (DC 19), touch of idiocy; 3rd—deep slumber (DC 20)
Evocation: 1st—magic missile, shocking grasp; 2nd—gust of wind (DC 19), scorching ray; 3rd—fireball (DC 20)
Illusion: 1st—color spray (DC 18), vanish; 2nd—blur, hypnotic pattern (DC 19); 3rd—displacement
Necromancy: 1st—cause fear (DC 18), ray of enfeeblement (DC 18); 2nd—blindness/deafness (DC 19), scare (DC 19); 3rd—ray of exhaustion (DC 20)
Transmutation: 1st—expeditious retreat, reduce person (DC 18); 2nd—alter self, spider climb; 3rd—haste

ABOUT

Environment any land
Organization solitary
Treasure none

This faceless construct has a crystal wand set into its chest, bristling with arcane energy.

An ingenious combination of mechanical devices and magical conduits allows a clockwork mage to channel the power of a spell gem into a variety of arcane powers. They often serve powerful arcane spellcasters, or as unflinching and unquestioning casters to those who wants the benefit of spells without ego or free thought. A humanoid figure of mithral, steel, and vapor-filled crystals, a clockwork mage often drapes itself in a cloak or shroud. It stands 7 feet tall.
